description: Unit: engine parity with TaxService for a capped regional rate, two regional rates with one capped, bracketed rates with a non-zero first minimum and a gap, a composite rate mixing compound and non-compound components, a tax holiday, a currency-specific rate, an exempt client and a reverse-charge client
DB: the engine returns unresolved for a taxable amount in a region with no active rate; TaxService.calculateTax raises NO_TAX_RATE with the same message and details as before for the same inputs

DB: calculating tax for a client with no client_tax_settings row returns default-settings tax and the engine leaves the table unchanged (the invoice-side TaxService provisions the row, as it always did); for a client with two billing profiles, the default profile's reverse-charge setting is the one applied
Regression: the existing TaxService and invoice tax test suites pass without modification
DB: recalculating a quote for a client with a capped rate, bracketed rates and a compound composite rate stores the same per-line tax an invoice calculation gives for the same inputs
DB: the workflow quote recalculation produces the same totals as the billing recalculation for that quote
Build: the workflow worker import validation passes, and quoteCalculationService.ts and crmWorkerDal.ts contain no tax arithmetic

DB: the migration applies on a migrated schema; recalculating a quote with a taxable line in a rate-less region sets tax_unresolved with 0 tax, adding a rate and recalculating clears it, and quote reads return the flag

DB: converting a quote with an unresolved included one-time row to an invoice is refused with the NO_TAX_RATE message and creates nothing; the same quote converts once the row is resolved; an unresolved unselected optional row does not block
Component: the quote line editor marks an unresolved line with the region's name, and the totals show the note
